description: NOAA Global Surge and Tide Operational Forecast System 2-D (STOFS-2D-Global) is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags), a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "water", published or maintained by NOAA. NOTICE - The Coast Survey Development Laboratory (CSDL) in NOAA/National Ocean Service (NOS)/Office of Coast Survey has upgraded the Surge and Tide Operational Forecast System (STOFS) to Version 3.1. A Service Change Notice (SCN) has been issued and can be found " HERE. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag water and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: Four times per day, every 6 hours starting at midnight UTC. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is stated as "NOAA data disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired." on the registry page. Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws-urban-water-hazard-tags.
